[LLEX.9.8] **A grammar word's class.** [LLEX.9.6]'s `Class` column sorts the
words reserved by `grammar` by the role the grammar gives them, and is empty on
every other row. A word's class is the first row of this table that holds for
it:

| Class | The word is |
|---|---|
| `declaration` | the first word of a `use_decl` or a `top_level_decl` alternative ([LGRA.3.1]), or of an import form ([LIMP.2.1.1]) |
| `action` | the first word of an `action_head` ([LGRA.10.1]) |
| `operator` | a word of the expression productions ([LGRA.9.3.1]) |
| `constant` | a word of the `is` subject vocabulary's constants ([LGRA.9.3.3]) |
| `clause` | any other word the grammar reserves |

The class changes nothing about a word's reservation or the code its refusal
carries ([LLEX.9.5], [LLEX.9.7]). It is how a tool that presents DS source
groups the grammar's words.
